usage: 凍檸水 is a noun used to refer to a specific drink made of iced lemon water.
You can use 凍檸水 when ordering drinks at a restaurant or cafe.
凍檸水 can be the subject or object in a sentence, like '我想飲凍檸水' meaning 'I want to drink iced lemon water'.
The word 凍檸水 is often used in casual conversations when talking about refreshing drinks.
凍檸水 can be combined with verbs like 飲 (to drink) or 買 (to buy) because it is a noun.
